## Names

<a id="check_background_touch"></a>
### [`check_background_touch`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L10) `$2E39`

*routine*

Main loop: background touch of each active actor that is not dying (state $19). An actor in state $17 (ride) first goes back to stand; touching the moving character $62 again restores it. touch_tile_gate = actor_contact,X bit 1: the lanterns and the deadly tiles count only when it is set. The actor position becomes a column actor_cell_col,X and a tile row actor_cell_row,X (actor_calc_tile_pos); then 3 characters of that text line and 3 of the line below are checked (check_tile_row).

- **Called from:** [`main_loop`](../game/game_main_loop.md#main_loop) [`$1C10`](../../../../src/game/game_main_loop.asm#L63)
- **Calls:** [`reset_actor_stand`](actor_helpers.md#reset_actor_stand), [`actor_calc_tile_pos`](../game/game_main_loop.md#actor_calc_tile_pos), [`check_tile_row`](background_touch.md#check_tile_row)

<a id="handle_touched_tile"></a>
### [`handle_touched_tile`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L61) `$2E89`

*routine*

Action of character A touched by actor current_actor at (row_ptr_top),Y: 2-5 exit markers (take_exit2..5), $62 moving character (touch_climb_tile), $2D/$2E room 16 bonus. When touch_tile_gate is nonzero also: $13, $14, $31 lantern (Bruce only); $0F, $40, $64, $54-$5A except $57, $71-$7C deadly; $66 deadly in rooms 10-19; $60 trap tile.

<a id="collect_lantern"></a>
### [`collect_lantern`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L142) `$2F04`

*label*

Lantern touched (Bruce only): find it in the lantern list of the room (check_lantern_pickup; carry set = not there or already taken; it decrements the lantern count of the room). Draw the background character it returns over the tile (top character, and character + $80 on the next line), add 125 points and start sound effect $8E.

<a id="take_exit2"></a>
### [`take_exit2`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L178) `$2F3C`

*label*

Exit marker characters 2-5: when the actor stands at the matching screen edge (check_exit_edge), it leaves to room exitN_dest_room,room with entry X exitN_entry_x,room and entry Y exitN_entry_y,room (N = 2..5). An entry X of 0 falls through to the next exit table.

<a id="enter_room"></a>
### [`enter_room`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L222) `$2F8E`

*label*

Moves actor current_actor to room next_room at X = A, Y = Y. An enemy is only removed (remove_actor) and the check of the other actors goes on. Also jumped to by act_wall_bump (room restart) and place_bruce_at_room_start.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$24EA`](../../../../src/actor/actor_hit_states.asm#L136), [`handle_touched_tile`](background_touch.md#handle_touched_tile) [`$2F4F`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L188), [`handle_touched_tile`](background_touch.md#handle_touched_tile) [`$2F64`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L198), [`handle_touched_tile`](background_touch.md#handle_touched_tile) [`$2F79`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L209), [`place_bruce_at_room_start`](../room/room_misc_support.md#place_bruce_at_room_start) [`$3225`](../../../../src/room/room_misc_support.asm#L19)

<a id="change_room"></a>
### [`change_room`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L234) `$2F9A`

*label*

Bruce changes the room: store his entry position, set room = next_room. Each active enemy keeps its energy in enemy_follow_energy and Bruce's entry position in enemy_follow_x/enemy_follow_y (index actor - 1; it follows him); an absent enemy gets enemy_follow_x/_y = 0. The enemies are removed, the spawn timers restart (reset_spawn_timer), the stack is reset and the new room is drawn (draw_room); then the sprites are built and the main loop restarts.

- **Jumped to from:** [`handle_touched_tile`](background_touch.md#handle_touched_tile) [`$2F90`](../../../../src/actor/background_touch.asm#L224)
